== June 2017 partial and full-image chronology ==
The shared [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|official PDF]], cover dated text as of June 1, 2017, prints this partial on page 13. Full sources are first located in repository records dated 8 July 2018, 20 December 2020, 18 March 2024 at 04:00:05 UTC, 18 March 2024 at 05:50:55 UTC. These records do not establish original first publication days. Descending moves preserve article/Talk histories and existing source assets. Existing current gameplay <code>1_288</code> and its Card redirect remain on the Decipher Errata article. These image publications invent no separate blueprint ID. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== Rule-derived location values ==
The original Decipher Glossary (1998), PDF page 84, explicitly gives all locations destiny 0 and no deploy cost; they deploy for free. Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF pages 83–84, agrees. The article records destiny 0 as a rule-derived value separately from what the partial actually prints. It does not infer a printed deploy-cost stat of zero. Sources: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]], [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf]]. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
